qwen_primary.scope: CORE first（6个核心项目）; evidence/facts/metrics; quota-limited

agy_parallel_fallback.scope: CORE parallel project signals + Qwen quota fallback + REFERENCE coarse scan

opus_specialist.scope: only difficult conflicts/high-impact cross-source reasoning; not bulk

final_synthesis.scope: cross-source Knowledge/Project/Data draft after evidence reconciliation

quota_and_persistence.unit_of_commit: one SourceVersion result at a time
quota_and_persistence.write_pattern: write .partial -> fsync/close -> atomic rename to final JSON
quota_and_persistence.on_qwen_quota: stop new Qwen calls, retain all completed outputs, mark QWEN_PAUSED_QUOTA, enqueue unprocessed CORE SourceVersions to queues/agy_fallback_pending.jsonl; never delete or restart completed results
quota_and_persistence.session_strategy: independent per SourceVersion; no single long session as sole state carrier

project_priority.REFERENCE_MODE: 其余资料 Reader 全量保留；语义层粗扫并在发现与核心项目有规则/数据/时间线关联时升级深读
